request.raw_text: Make the part symmetrical with respect to ZX plane by adding lowered plateau to the bottom. Then add embossed text to the top to distinguish the top (text should be "TOP", Arial, 10mm height, 1mm raised above lowered plateau, not sticking out of the plateau, approximately centered to the middle).

areas_to_change.action: Create a lowered plateau matching the existing top-side lowered plateau.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Existing recessed rectangular plateau in the central handle and the ZX symmetry plane.
areas_to_change.location: Bottom face of the straight central handle, opposite the existing top plateau.
areas_to_change.description: Add a bottom-side recessed or lowered plateau mirrored from the existing top-side plateau so the part's base geometry is symmetric about the ZX plane.

areas_to_change.action: Add raised embossed text with content "TOP", Arial font, 10 mm character height, and 1 mm emboss height.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Top-side lowered plateau in the middle of the handle.
areas_to_change.location: Approximately centered within the top lowered plateau.
areas_to_change.description: Place the text entirely within the plateau boundary and raise it 1 mm from the plateau floor. Orient it for normal reading along the handle and use it to identify the top side.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the open-ended wrench head, circular ring end, handle outline, neck transitions, and all current external planform dimensions.
Preserve the jaw opening geometry and the circular through-hole without changing their size, location, or orientation.
Preserve its footprint, depth, corner treatment, and position except for adding the specified embossed text on its floor.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Part thickness and surrounding outer faces
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Do not alter the nominal thickness or outer top and bottom perimeter surfaces outside the added bottom plateau and top text.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The wrench will have matching lowered rectangular plateaus on the top and bottom of the central handle, making the underlying part symmetric about the ZX plane. The top plateau will additionally contain centered raised Arial text reading "TOP", with 10 mm text height and a 1 mm emboss.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The mirrored bottom plateau balances the handle geometry, while the embossed label provides a clear tactile and visual indication of the intended top side.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The wrench's engagement features and primary mechanical envelope remain unchanged. The text remains confined to the top plateau and does not extend beyond its footprint; the label intentionally makes the final labeled object visually asymmetric even though the base plateau geometry is symmetric.

ambiguities.description: The phrase "not sticking out of the plateau" can describe either the text footprint or its vertical extent.
candidate_interpretations: Keep the complete text footprint inside the plateau boundary.
Keep the top of the 1 mm emboss at or below the surrounding unrecessed top face.

ambiguities.description: The requested ZX-plane symmetry conflicts literally with adding text only to the top, because the text breaks final geometric symmetry.
candidate_interpretations: Make the base wrench symmetric by adding the bottom plateau, then intentionally break visible symmetry with the top-only label.
Require symmetry only for the plateau features, excluding the identifying text.

ambiguities.description: The reading direction of "TOP" along the elongated handle is not explicitly specified.
candidate_interpretations: Orient the baseline across the handle width, with the word readable in the provided +Y view.
Orient the baseline along the handle length and center the word in the plateau.
